images.note: CIA briefing board prepared for JFK showing the range arcs of Soviet MRBMs based in Cuba — the actual visual used to brief the president; serves the 'mirror image' beat (US Jupiters in Turkey vs Soviet missiles in Cuba). Verified: HTTP 200, image/jpeg, 2.2 MB, 2790x3236. BLOCKER for alt_url: no qualifying Jupiter-missile-in-Turkey photograph found at the bar — NMUSAF, history.navy.mil, army.mil and DVIDS all block non-browser fetches; the only large Cigli/Turkey Jupiter photos are Wikimedia-hosted (banned); NASA's Jupiter holdings are of the Jupiter-C (a different missile) or wind-tunnel models. The range board is the closest verified institutional visual for the range/mirror concept.
images.source: National Security Archive, George Washington University (Dino A. Brugioni collection)
images.title: CIA briefing board showing range of Soviet MRBMs in Cuba, prepared for President Kennedy

Verified: HEAD HTTP 200, image/jpeg; GET 200, image/jpeg, 1.4 MB, 3920x5000.
